additionalProperties.description: A route (path + controller) or an import of routes (resource), keyed by route name or import name. Keys starting with when@ hold routes for one environment only.

path.description: URL path with {placeholders}, or a map of locale to path for localized routes.

controller.description: Controller to call: Class::method, a service id with ::method, or an invokable controller class.

methods.description: HTTP methods the route matches; any method when left out.

requirements.description: Regex per placeholder that the value must match.

defaults.description: Default values for placeholders and request attributes, for example _format or _controller.

options.description: Route options. Oro reads expose: true to make the route available in JS through FOSJsRouting.

host.description: Host the route matches, can contain placeholders.

condition.description: Expression that must be true for the route to match, with context and request available.

locale.description: Sets _locale in the defaults and requirements.

format.description: Sets _format in the defaults and requirements.

utf8.description: true allows UTF-8 characters in the path and requirements.

stateless.description: true marks the route as not using the session; Symfony then fails when the session is used.

resource.description: Imports routes from a file, directory, controller class (with type attribute) or a namespace.

type.description: Loader for resource: attribute for #[Route] on controllers, directory, glob, or a custom loader.

prefix.description: Path prefix added to every imported route, or a map of locale to prefix.

name_prefix.description: Prefix added to the name of every imported route.

trailing_slash_on_root.description: false stops the prefix from adding a trailing slash to an imported route whose path is /.

exclude.description: Paths or globs left out of resource.
